The bug has been fixed and verified against the requirement.

### Cause of the Bug
In [`Frequency.getPct(Object v)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_75_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/stat/Frequency.java#L302-L304), the implementation erroneously called `getCumPct((Comparable<?>) v)` instead of delegating to `getPct((Comparable<?>) v)`. This returned the cumulative percentage instead of the individual frequency percentage for an `Object` argument.

### Solution
Updated [`Frequency.getPct(Object v)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_75_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math/stat/Frequency.java#L302-L304) to call `getPct((Comparable<?>) v)`.

The focused patch was saved to [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_75_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch) and all Cucumber verification tests passed.
